units.source_text: 皇太子闻知父皇患病，并决心出家奉佛，便亲赴朱雀院问省。

en.t: When the Crown Prince heard that his father was ill and had resolved to renounce the world and enter Buddhist life, he went in person to Suzaku-in to inquire after him.

units.source_text: 母亲承香殿女御陪同前来。

en.t: His mother, the Consort of Shokyoden, came with him.

units.source_text: 朱雀院对此女御并不十分宠爱，但因太子是她所生，宿世因缘甚深，所以也很重视她，和她详谈年来种种事情。

en.t: Suzaku-in had never loved this consort very deeply, but because she was the Crown Prince's mother and their bond from former lives was profound, he still treated her with great regard and spoke with her in detail about all that had happened over the years.

units.source_text: 对皇太子也说了许多话，就中也谈到治世之道。

en.t: He also said many things to the Crown Prince, among them speaking of the proper way to govern the realm.

units.source_text: 皇太子长得很老成，看来似乎不止十三岁。

en.t: The Crown Prince had grown very mature for his age and looked as though he were more than thirteen.

units.source_text: 照顾他的人，如明石妃子等，都很可靠，所以大可放心。

en.t: Those who cared for him, including the Lady Akashi, were all dependable, so there was every reason to feel at ease.

units.source_text: 朱雀院对他说了如下的话：“

en.t: Suzaku-in spoke to him as follows: "
I no longer have any attachment to this world.

units.source_text: 只是所遗女儿众多，挂念彼等前程，于‘不可免’的‘死别’不无障碍耳。

en.t: Only, I leave behind many daughters, and my concern for their futures is no small hindrance even to the unavoidable parting of death.

units.source_text: 就往日在别人家所见所闻之事看来，凡为女子者，往往遭逢意外之变而身受侮辱，其命运实甚可悯可悲。

en.t: Judging from what I have seen and heard in other households in the past, women often meet with unexpected misfortunes and suffer humiliation; their fate is truly pitiable and sad.

units.source_text: 将来你倘能得意临朝，务望多多留意，好好照拂你的姐妹。

en.t: If in the future you are fortunate enough to rule from the throne, I earnestly hope you will give careful thought to your sisters and look after them well.

units.source_text: 其中有后援人者，原可听其自行做主。

en.t: Those among them who have someone to support them may of course be allowed to decide for themselves.

units.source_text: 惟三公主年事尚幼，一向靠我一人照拂，今我即将出家，任她漂泊于世，我心实甚挂念，思之不胜悲伤耳。”

en.t: But the Third Princess is still young and has always depended on me alone for care; now that I am about to take vows, the thought of leaving her adrift in the world weighs heavily on my heart and fills me with grief."

units.source_text: 他一面拭泪，一面诉说衷情。

en.t: As he wiped away his tears, he poured out the feelings in his heart.
